findings.description: The new code strips the leading dot from each no_proxy entry and then always prepends one before the endswith check. This changes the matching rules. A bare entry like `example.com` used to match `notexample.com` by raw suffix, and it now matches only the exact host or a subdomain. Any code or tests that relied on the old suffix behavior will see different results.
findings.rationale: Trigger: no_proxy=example.com with a request to notexample.com. Before the change, the raw endswith check bypassed the proxy. Now `.example.com` is not a suffix of `notexample.com`, so the request goes through the proxy. Entries like `.example.com` also now match the bare `example.com`, which they did not match before. The behavior change is arguably a fix and was probably intended, so confidence is low.
